description: This Java class implements a mock or test connection factory that provides access to disconnect handlers, simulating connection attempts and failures for testing purposes within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: DisconnectHandlerProvidingConnectionFactory
classes.description: A mock connection factory used for testing disconnect handlers and connection attempts, supporting simulation of failures and success scenarios.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Simulates establishing a connection, either succeeding with a predefined connection object or failing based on internal counters.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a fixed name identifying this connection factory.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns a fixed host name for the simulated connection.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns a fixed port number for the simulated connection.

methods.name: getPathSeparator
methods.description: Returns the default path separator constant.

methods.name: setExpectedFailingConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Configures how many connection attempts should fail before success.

methods.name: setExpectedSucceedingConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Configures how many successful connection attempts are expected.

methods.name: failWith
methods.description: Sets the failure cause for subsequent connection attempts.

methods.name: await
methods.description: Blocks until the expected number of successful connection attempts have occurred.

methods.name: awaitFailure
methods.description: Blocks until the expected number of failing connection attempts have occurred.
